It isn't just about feeding an AI general knowledge; it’s about giving it access to *our* specific operational data. For example, if we were trying to build a system to predict wait times for the thrill rides, instead of asking a large model what the average wait time is generally, RAG lets us retrieve specific, real-time data from our internal database—say, closure alerts or queue management logs—and feed *only* that precise information to the LLM. researchHistory.query: What is one useful thing to notice or learn while visiting Forest Frontiers?
researchHistory.text: One useful thing to notice or learn is to be mindful of your movement and timing when entering the park, especially concerning queues. For example, if you are looking for a specific ride, be aware that rushing straight toward the entrance without pausing at the **Ride Entrance Gatehouse** first risks wasting valuable time waiting.
